race_empire.name: Empire
race_empire.temper: Practical, loud and loyal to the Lion Throne; they pay for help in bread, steel and favours.

race_high_elves.name: High Elves
race_high_elves.temper: Proud, patient and old; they measure time in moons and trust short-lived folk only after a deed.

bld_empire_archway.name: Archway
bld_empire_archway.text: The village gate and notice board: read your reputation, the open quests and who gives them here.

bld_empire_barn.name: Barn
bld_empire_barn.text: Farmhands and builders come from the barn, one every 20 turns.

bld_empire_barracks.name: Barracks
bld_empire_barracks.text: Pikemen drill here; a new one joins the watch every 20 turns while the village is below its cap.

bld_empire_blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
bld_empire_blacksmith.text: The smith fletches and arms an Archer every 30 turns.

bld_empire_granary.name: Granary
bld_empire_granary.text: The village stores; burn it and the village will not forget.

bld_empire_library.name: Library
bld_empire_library.text: The chronicler keeps the Dimension's records here.

bld_empire_palace.name: Palace
bld_empire_palace.text: The reeve's hall; a Halberdier of the guard is sworn in every 40 turns.

bld_empire_quartermaster.name: Quartermaster
bld_empire_quartermaster.text: The quartermaster has supplies — and errands for strangers.

bld_high_elves_dragon_shrine.name: Dragon Shrine
bld_high_elves_dragon_shrine.text: Wisps gather at the shrine; one wakes every 25 turns to help with the building.

bld_high_elves_dragonstone.name: Dragonstone
bld_high_elves_dragonstone.text: Old runes on the stone; the lorekeeper reads them to whoever listens.

bld_high_elves_merchant.name: Merchant
bld_high_elves_merchant.text: The merchant trades in favours: she has work for strangers.

bld_high_elves_shooting_range.name: Shooting Range
bld_high_elves_shooting_range.text: Longbows train here; a new one joins the watch every 20 turns while the village is below its cap.

bld_high_elves_tower_of_the_moon.name: Tower of the Moon
bld_high_elves_tower_of_the_moon.text: The Iceguard keep vigil here; one is sent down every 30 turns.

bld_high_elves_tree_of_gold.text: The village heart. Its leaves turn the colour of your standing with the village: read your reputation, the open quests and who gives them here.

bld_high_elves_white_tower.name: White Tower
bld_high_elves_white_tower.text: The keep of the village; once in a long while a Moonguard steps out of it.

wall.name: Palisade
wall.text: A palisade of sharpened stakes: no way in but the gate, and the Gate Sergeant opens it only to friends of the village.

wall.name: Moonwall
wall.text: The moonwall of white stone: no way in but its one gate, and the Gatekeeper opens it only to friends of the village.

npc_high_elves_elder.name: Elder

greet: Welcome, short-lived one. Walk softly here.
The trees told me you were coming.
quest: Bring me {need}, and the village will remember your name.
We lack {need}. Find it — the map hides it somewhere — and return.
thanks: {need}! The moon-wards wake again. Take our thanks.
